name: Education (General)

sections.title: Program Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Successful completion, within five years, of an approved program comprised of 30 units of upper division or graduate course work and any necessary prerequisites is required.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: A minimum of 15 of the 30 units must be earned in education and/or educational professional courses and a maximum of 12 may be transfer units.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students must maintain a 2.5 GPA for courses used toward the diploma.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Courses completed during the EDUC 404 term may not be used toward a post baccalaureate diploma.

sections.note: Courses completed within 10 years of starting the post baccalaureate diploma may (with permission) be considered as part of the requirements for the diploma.

grades.label: Program Requirements
